ran trif run 'const s=document.querySelector("svg.robot"); return {html:s.outerHTML, parent:s.parentElement.outerHTML.slice(0,300), anim:getComputedStyle(s).animationName, tr:getComputedStyle(s).transform}'; trif status

The robot is an inline SVG with one glowing group for the eyes. Plan: legs tucked under his head, a walk cycle driven by how far he actually moves, a set of little routines to wander in, and robot noises made with Web Audio, so nothing is loaded.

ran trif check timsrobot.com/robot && trif reload && trif run 'const s=document.querySelector("svg.robot"); const out=[]; for(let i=0;i<8;i++){ await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1000)); out.push([s.style.translate, s.c…
The legs barely show: a gradient on a perfectly vertical line doesn't paint in SVG. Switching them to a solid green.

ran trif reload && trif run 'const s=document.querySelector("svg.robot"); s.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent("pointerenter")); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); s.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent("click",{bubbles:true})); aw…
Walking and hopping work. Checking the sounds are set up, since I can't hear anything from here.
ran trif run 'const s=document.querySelector("svg.robot"); return {legs:s.querySelectorAll(".lr-leg").length, audio:typeof AudioContext, walking:getComputedStyle(s).translate}'; trif errors

The robot is alive. I added a new mod, **Living Robot**:

- **Legs:** two little green legs. They swing with each step, his feet point where he's going and he leans into it. Walking up or down the page, he marches.
- **Walking around:** he runs little routines on his own: strolls, a hop and a dash, loop-the-loops, figure eights, zigzags, pacing like a sentry, peeking from the edge of the screen, spirals and a hop dance, with pauses in between. Now and then he heads back home. He stays on screen, and stops while your pointer is over him.
- **Robot noises:** a soft tap for each footstep, a boing when he hops, and now and then, when he stops to think, a happy little murmur ("mm-hm?", "hm, hm!" or "brr-up?", never the same one twice in a row).
- **Startle:** tap or click him and he jumps with a boing and a startled blink.
- **Also:** his eyes follow your mouse, and he blinks every few seconds.

**What I checked:** after a reload he set off on his own, the screenshot shows him mid-stride with his legs showing, and clicking him made him jump. No errors. Browsers only play sound after you've clicked or pressed a key on the page, so he's quiet until then; I can't hear from here, so give him a listen.

To undo it, switch off **Living Robot** in the side panel, or ask me to.
